cells.gaps: No source found says the backbone reaches every department, or that other operators buy capacity on it.
cells.note: Fact 2026-11-05: the French Treasury reports about 3,000 km of PCN fibre linking Brazzaville to Pointe-Noire, Dolisie, Oyo and Ouesso, operated by Congo Telecom (COG-002), so fibre is in service beyond the capital. No source says it reaches every department, so not 4.
